Why start from a stock formula

Faster to shelf

The formulas are developed and in production, so the work moves straight to what makes it OLLY: flavor, claims and pack.

Built to be customized

Change flavors, adjust doses, add OLLY’s signature actives or change pack sizes. The stock formula is the starting point, not the limit.

Quality you can audit

Identity, potency, micro and stability testing on every formula, with a COA for every batch.

Ingredients

Whey protein concentrate 80% (rBGH-free, non-GMO), natural flavoring, xanthan gum, sucralose, L. acidophilus (10 billion), Prohydroxy (amylase, lactase, lipase, protease I, protease II), egg albumin, instant micellar casein, whey protein isolate.

Minerals per serving
  • Phosphorus 120 mg (10% DV)
  • Magnesium 20 mg (5% DV)
  • Potassium 120 mg (3% DV)
  • Iron 0.3 mg (2% DV)
  • Not a significant source of vitamin D
Allergens
  • Contains: egg, milk
  • Produced in a facility that also processes soy, fish, shellfish, milk, peanuts, tree nuts, wheat, eggs and sesame
